page.overview:
Who is Cranky Cookie?

The statue of Cranky Cookie appears in the episode "Five More Short Graybles". Shelby is reading a book atop the statue's fist when he says hello to Tree Trunks. After accidentally running into the statue, Tree Trunks begins to cry because Shelby's positioning on the statue's fist looked as if it was making a rude gesture towards her.

He looks like a gingerbread man, and he is seen wearing gloves and boots. He has chocolate chip eyes and two chocolate chip buttons on the front of his body.
